[&hellip;] What I know about programming you could inscribe on a microdiode lead with a dull sword.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Koth Melan]]|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''programmer''' was someone who developed programs and software. [[Luwingo]] worked as a programmer on his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] before becoming a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].
